items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: He was a White band. Wade King, yeah. He played all that beautiful straight alto.

ctx.x: No. He was a White band. Wade King, yeah. He played all that beautiful straight alto. Never did play no solo. Nothing but just straight lead. He had a solo, but it was straight lead.
Would the Blue Devils ever do gigs where you were expected to play like that all night?
